title: Cardiac Pulse & ECG
subtitle: Electrocardiogram Fourier Waveform & Vascular Rhythm
description: Biomedical cardiovascular simulation combining the classic mathematical cardioid heart contraction with a multi-Gaussian P-QRS-T electrocardiogram trace.
mathNotation: V_{\text{ECG}}(t) = \sum_{i \in \{P, Q, R, S, T\}} a_i \exp\left( -\frac{(t - \mu_i)^2}{2\sigma_i^2} \right), \quad x(t) = 16\sin^3(t), \quad y(t) = -(13\cos t - 5\cos 2t - 2\cos 3t - \cos 4t)
